title: Harbison Protection Contracts Terms: Contracts Held by One Customer
content:
**Condition 1. Number of contracts.** A customer may hold any number of Harbison Protection Contracts, one chain per unit or matched system at the service address. There is no per-customer cap on the number of contracts.

**Condition 2. What one contract covers.** Each contract covers only the unit named on it, together with the paired unit when its scope is a matched system.

**Condition 3. Contracts are kept apart.** Claims, limits and fees are kept per contract: a claim is booked against one contract, the claim benefit drawn is that contract's benefit, and a fee is charged on that contract.

**Points of reading.**

| Holding | Permitted under these conditions |
|---|---|
| One customer, two units at the service address, one contract on each unit | yes, one chain per unit |
| One customer, five contracts across five units or matched systems | yes, there is no per-customer cap |
| A matched-system contract | covers the named unit and its paired unit |

Hypothetical illustration: a household with a furnace and air conditioner covered as a matched system and a separate ductless unit may hold one contract on the matched system and another on the ductless unit; a claim on the ductless unit draws only on the second contract's claim benefit.
